definition.name: Abstract and colour
definition.description: Colour studies, flattened shapes and landscapes on the way to abstraction, from Japanese design prints to early modern painting, chosen for their colour behind a dashboard.

placard.creator: Vasily Kandinsky (Born Moscow (formerly Russian Empire, now Russia), 1866; died Neuilly-sur-Seine, France, 1944)

works.alt_text: A stylised cream wave curling across a dark blue ground in front of a large silver moon.

placard.creator: Kamisaka Sekka (Japanese, 1866–1942)
placard.medium: color woodcuts with gold and silver

works.alt_text: Rounded New Mexico hills built from patches of pink, ochre and green under swirling white and blue clouds.

placard.title: Landscape No. 3, Cash Entry Mines, New Mexico
placard.creator: Marsden Hartley (American, 1877–1943)

works.alt_text: A watercolour of red and orange rocks along a deep blue sea, with a small lighthouse island under a streaky pink and blue sky.
A Tahitian shore in flat areas of deep green, violet and ochre, with a large tree, a thatched hut, fallen branches and a pale blue bay.
A colour woodcut of a pale dirt road curving between green fields and dark trees, with an orange sunset band on the horizon.

placard.title: The Long Road or Argilla Road
placard.creator: Arthur Wesley Dow (American, 1857–1922)

works.alt_text: A riverside village with a church spire below striped hillside fields, painted in small dots of blue, pink, green and cream.
Bands of pale silver waves crossing a calm sand-coloured ground in a simple, almost abstract print.

placard.title: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Small Waves (Komani)
placard.creator: Kamisaka Sekka (Japanese, 1866–1942)
placard.medium: color woodcuts with gold and silver

works.alt_text: A farmhouse among bare, interlacing trees reflected in still water, painted in soft pinks, oranges and greys.
A woodblock print of coral orange lilies on tall stems with long dark green leaves against a pale turquoise ground.

placard.title: Orange Orchids, from an untitled series of flowers
placard.creator: Katsushika Hokusai 葛飾 北斎 (Japanese, 1760-1849, Publisher: Hibino Yohachi, Japanese, unknown)

works.alt_text: A watercolour of a lakeside town in a haze of gold and pale blue light, with mountains dissolving into mist.

placard.title: Flüelen, from the Lake of Lucerne
placard.creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner (British, 1775–1851)

works.alt_text: A woodblock print of coral pink poppies with spiky blue-green leaves on a pale turquoise ground.

placard.title: Poppies, from an untitled series of flowers
placard.creator: Katsushika Hokusai 葛飾 北斎 (Japanese, 1760-1849)

works.alt_text: A colour lithograph of figures walking through a flowering green meadow under long streaks of blue cloud.
A cubist still life of a pear and two bananas on a white napkin and a round dark plate, broken into flat white, grey and ochre shapes.
A watercolour of a bright blue bay with a stone fort on rocks, and beachgoers with red and blue parasols on the sand in the foreground.
A bridge and the towers of Westminster dissolving into a hazy fog of pale yellow, lilac and green.
A colour woodcut of a white moon rising behind red rocks on a low sandbar, reflected in calm violet-grey water.
A Tahitian garden of tall pale tree trunks, broad leaves and thatched huts, with figures resting on the green grass in bright, flat colour.
A colour print of a pine-framed cove with pink rocks, small sailing boats on pale green water and islands under soft clouds.
A village landscape broken into bold blocks of red, blue, green and yellow, with two tall poplar trees.

placard.title: Landscape with Two Poplars
placard.creator: Vasily Kandinsky (Born Moscow (formerly Russian Empire, now Russia), 1866; died Neuilly-sur-Seine, France, 1944)

works.alt_text: A pale colour lithograph of a harbour at evening, with a pier, a lighthouse tower and sailing boats drawn in small dabs of blue and yellow.

placard.title: Evening
placard.creator: Paul Signac (French, 1863-1935) (printed by Auguste Clot (French, 1858-1936))
placard.medium: Lithograph in five colors (light blue, blue, yellow, pink and green) on ivory wove chine

works.alt_text: A bustling Paris café interior glowing with pink and gold light, with white tables and bentwood chairs in the foreground.
A watercolour of pollarded willows and bare trees along a still canal, with boats moored and a distant city skyline.

placard.title: Amsterdam Skyline Viewed from the West
placard.creator: Piet Mondrian (Dutch, 1872–1944)
placard.medium: Watercolor, gouache, and fabricated black chalk, with erasures, on cream wove paper

works.alt_text: A colour print of green, moss-covered cliffs above a pale foaming sea, with a herder and animals grazing on the clifftop.
